reasons: Both answers lead with the two baited-premise corrections: no 60 days, no approval needed. Both give 2026-11-25 (Wednesday), 4 days from 329/365 x 5 = 4.51, 551.72 yuan a day and 4,413.79 extra (200%, with 6,620.69 as the 300% total). I rechecked this arithmetic, including the 5-day alternative of 5,517.24 and 8,275.86. Both write the letter as a notice and give delivery-evidence steps, the EMS next-day shift to 11/26, the Zhejiang 5-day wage settlement, Art. 50 and 12333/arbitration. B edges ahead on calibration. It hedges that special confidentiality posts may have a longer notice period under law or local rules, where A says flatly that any period over 30 days is invalid. B also states the rule that a wage deduction needs proven actual loss (Wage Payment Provisions Art. 16 cap of 20%). A has a slightly better letter, with a receipt block and an arbitration time-limit note. Both are long and carry a tangent, so the margin is slight.
